abstract.t: Using a distinct holder-binding key for each Credential improves unlinkability, but generating and storing many keys in a Wallet secure area can be expensive or impossible. This document defines a way to derive unlinkable P-256 Credential keys from one protected parent key while retaining the parent's key-protection properties. It specifies this mechanism as an extension to OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance (OpenID4VCI), allowing the Issuer to derive each child public key while only the Wallet can use the corresponding child private key.
